# DexenTech

> DexenTech builds AI operational systems for hospitality and B2B commerce —
> software that runs bookings, orders, and operations from one place rather
> than across ten disconnected tools.

## What we build

- **HospitalityOS** — one operating system per property. Bookings, housekeeping,
  guests, and finance synced across Booking.com, Airbnb, Expedia, and VRBO in a
  single calendar. Overbookings go to zero.
- **SupplyFlowOS** — B2B commerce for distributors. Ordering portal, CRM,
  inventory, and workforce wired together end to end.
- **AI Intelligence Systems** — MCP integrations, multi-agent workflows,
  monitoring, and cost control for teams whose systems need to reason.

## Industries served

Independent hotels, hostel groups, short-term rental management, serviced
apartments, boutique hotels, industrial parts distributors, food and beverage
wholesale, construction materials suppliers, medical and laboratory suppliers,
manufacturing components distributors, chemical and industrial wholesalers.
